paragraphs: Two E. coli and Salmonella outbreaks have ended [1][2]. An E. coli O26 outbreak linked to raw milk cheese affected 18 people across 10 states, with 9 hospitalizations and no deaths [1]. A separate outbreak involving E. coli O26, O103, and O168 strains plus Salmonella Agona linked to alfalfa sprouts sickened 77 people across 16 states, with 6 hospitalizations and no deaths [2].

Family Farmstead Dairy is recalling all cheddar cheese products due to potential Listeria monocytogenes contamination [4]. Fresh & Ready Foods LLC is recalling Fresh To You Sausage, Egg & Cheese Biscuit Sandwiches (4.6 oz) for the same reason [5]. Listeria can cause serious and sometimes fatal infections in young children, elderly people, and those with weakened immune systems [4][5].

BETTERBALLEN FOODS LLC is recalling Clear vacuum-packed 6-piece "Bami Rolls" packages with "BEST BY" October 2027 and lot codes BR-2026-01 or BR-2026-02 due to unreported allergens [3]. The affected products were distributed in Georgia and South Carolina [3]. Sprouting seeds sold under Country Creek LLC's Country Creek Acres brand and the Francisco Family Foods brand are being recalled for possible Salmonella or E. coli contamination [17].
